body:
I removed the word "active", and updated the wordings around the <a download> call site.

The idea is:
For navigation, the "initiator" is the initiator document (CSP sandbox policy + inherited policy) and the "instantiator" is the iframe (current sandbox attributes + inherited policy) or top frame (interited policy from pop-up). For <a download>, the "initiator" is the document where the <a> is attached to; or the document where the <a> is created, if <a> hasn't been attached to a document yet. 

I think now the call sites are using the correct terms for the purpose above.
